verdict.rationale: Segment ships a well-documented Public API with CRUD access to core workspace resources (Sources, Destinations, Warehouses, Tracking Plans) plus a separate Profile API for querying user/account data, giving strong programmatic parity for data management and querying tasks that mirror the UI [segment-docs-4, segment-docs-18, segment-docs-x1, segment-docs-44]. However, evidence does not confirm API parity for other UI-driven features like building/managing Audiences in Engage, editing Functions, or configuring Privacy Portal/Consent Management settings — these are only described as UI or config-based capabilities. Missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for Audience creation/management, Functions authoring via API, and Privacy Portal/consent configuration via API, plus independent confirmation of full UI-API parity.
